title: Verify the size before you buy
text: Verify the size before you buy. The wording and design was easy to create. I thought I ordered the curved design but receive a more standard design. The larger size has the more sleek design. Still fun to commemorate an important day.

product_metadata.title: Graduation Gifts 2022, Personalized Graduation Mug with Name - 9 Colors, 2 Sizes, 9 Quotes - Class of 2022 College Graduation Gifts for Him, Her, High School Graduation Gifts for Daughter, Son
features: A THOUGHTFUL GIFT FOR NEW GRADUATES: During these rough pandemic times, graduation is a hardly-achieved goal. Therefore, we give you a chance to surprise a newly-graduated hero with a uniquely personalized gift that will keep him/her motivated and proud. Whether he/she was your son, daughter, grandson, granddaughter, brother, sister, best friend, boyfriend, or girlfriend, you can make sure they will have a wide smile when receiving your gift.

A USEFUL GIFT FOR ALL GRADUATIONS: It does not matter whether it was a graduation from a school, a high school, a college, a university, or an institution, our customized graduation mug will be a great gift for seniors who graduated or about to graduate. It is also a nice gift for BA, MBA, or Ph.D. graduates who finally got their master's or doctorate degrees.

MOTIVATIONAL DESIGNS WITH YOUR PERSONAL TOUCH: By clicking the "CUSTOMIZE NOW" button, you can choose the size of the mug (11 Oz or 15 Oz), one of 9 vivid colors for the mug, personalize the front side with a name and a university, college, or school's name, pick one of 8 colors for the graduation cap and select one of 9 motivational congratulating texts for the backside of the mug to make it a one-of-a-kind gift for you or a dear graduate.

MATERIAL: Our customized mugs are made from a durable ceramic material to preserve the temperature of beverages like coffee & tea, allowing you to enjoy every sip of your drink. The mugs are easy to clean & dishwasher safe, customized with permanent printing that won't fade away over time.

PROFESSIONAL USA-BASED COMPANY: We do all that it takes to produce the perfect personalized gifts for our customers with an experienced design, production, and customer service teams doing their best to help you get the best customized gifts you ask for.
